review_method.skill_use: Read the skill and applied its hierarchy, legibility, interaction-state and control-boundary principles to the frozen export. No skill search script was run and no new design direction was introduced.
static_text_sources: The assigned input JSON and its owner-frozen evidence identities
Frozen reference-scope.json precedence, shared contract, capability bounds, pw-reader and pw-settings sections
Frozen capture-plan.json matching reference cases, profile mapping and review contract
Each listed case JSON, standalone state, metadata, actions and log; route, panel, selected values, capability declaration, capture identity and evidence sections were read statically
The directly related pw-reader.dc.html light-panel excerpt was read as supporting reference geometry text only; it was never opened as an application
review_method.image_method: Every candidate below and every associated original reference below was actually opened with tools.view_image. Only the original PNG paths were used. No old pixels, contact sheets, local crops, copies, resized substitutes or generated image comparisons were used.
review_method.geometry_basis: All 13 case records declare native_capture_size 618x824 and physical_reference_scale 2. Original references are 1236x1648. Comparisons used the logical geometry implied by that factor without changing either file.
review_method.hash_provenance: All SHA256 values are transcribed from the owner-frozen module inventory carried by the assigned input, with case-sidecar identity fields read for association. No local rehash was performed or claimed.
review_method.separation: Static appearance observations are independent of mechanical passed fields. Recorded action/state support is stated separately and is not new execution or physical qualification.
review_method.closed_reader_precedence: The user override is absolute: artwork only when the menu is closed, with no persistent footer, bookmark ribbon, page/status label, download notice, decorative app border or invisible footer-cycle region. Reference footer/ribbon pixels were inspected but do not authorize restoration.
review_method.execution: Local static text reads, original-image views and writing this assigned report only. No local or remote test, build, smoke, runtime probe, validation suite, SSH, image processing or application execution was performed.
review_method.readability: All visible control labels and boundaries needed for this batch were readable in the actual original-image views. No additional original crop is requested for this batch. This is not a claim about physical e-ink legibility.

root_accepted_capability_dispositions.source: Root formal triage relayed by the parent coordinator during this review
root_accepted_capability_dispositions.raw_availability_observation: The candidate marks split-spread unavailable with a visible hint; the original reference shows it on. The frozen sidecar has no split capability field and intentional_differences is empty.
root_accepted_capability_dispositions.disposition: Root accepts the honest disabled software split control with its visible unavailable hint as a capability boundary. Retain the raw availability difference; do not report a new C5 product defect for split.
root_accepted_capability_dispositions.scope_limit: This acceptance applies only to split. It does not dispose of quality/refresh capability evidence or waive independently observed geometry, text or control-boundary problems.

limitations: This report covers only the 13 assigned PW reader/settings reference cases. It is not a full-round or clean-round acceptance and does not close any historical issue, including the historical 47-item set.
All hashes use the owner-frozen input provenance. Case identity fields were read for association; no local digest, schema validator or automated comparison was run.

Direct original-image observation establishes visible static appearance only. Recorded actions/state support the captured scene but are not new execution and do not establish all transitions, hidden hitboxes or input routing.

Desktop captures do not qualify physical e-ink waveforms, frontlight output, natural light, rotation sensors, evdev mapping, actual radio state, physical sleep/wake, performance or cache-lease behavior.

The two fullscreen original references were actually inspected. Their old ribbon/footer decorations remain superseded by the user's pure-artwork override, and neither alias is evidence of a footer implementation.
No independent regression assignment was included here. No earlier-run pixel conclusion or mechanical passed field was used as a substitute for these original-image views.
